Subject: Pathfinder Mutual Plan — evaluation runway & kickoff slides

Alex —

Great speaking with you yesterday. As promised, I’m sharing a first-pass mutual plan and a lightweight slide skeleton to help structure the pilot kickoff. Files attached and also linked below.

High-level asks from our side so we can finalize the MAP before the kickoff:
- Confirm the 2–3 primary success metrics for the pilot (latency, throughput, accuracy slice, etc.).
- Who should be tagged as stakeholder owners from your side (technical lead, procurement, security, product)?
- Any mandatory procurement windows or legal constraints we should work around this quarter?

Attachments included:
- pathfinder-mutual-plan-template-v0.1.gdoc (MAP draft)
- kickoff-slide-skeleton-v1.pptx (3-slide starter)

Proposed next steps:
1) You review the MAP draft and add comments directly to the doc.
2) We schedule a 45-minute kickoff workshop (agenda: goals, success metrics, test data, rollout path).

Slots that work for our team: Tue 6/22 10:00–11:00 PDT or Wed 6/23 14:00–14:45 PDT. If neither works, send a couple windows that do.

Link to docs: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1APathfinderMAPDraft
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/PF-2027-0911

Thanks — cc’ing Marissa (technical lead) and Ben (solutions) so they can prep the runbook and demo artifacts.

—Priyom

Thanks, Priyom — appreciate the fast turnaround. I skimmed the MAP and the structure looks good. A few quick notes before we schedule the kickoff:

- Primary metrics: we care about inference latency (p99), end-to-end request success rate for prioritized endpoints, and a sample-quality signal we can compute on a small labeled set.
- Stakeholders: I’ll be the exec owner; I’ll loop in our ML lead (Sasha Obradovic) and our SRE (Jamie Li) once we lock the kickoff. Procurement is on copy for timeline constraints.
- Procurement: we have a standard vendor review that can take up to 3 business days after legal signs off; procurement@pathfinder.ai will coordinate.

Security question: do you have a short checklist we can share with our security reviewer (SOC2 attestation, data residency, logging/audit capabilities)?

I can do Tue 6/22 10:00–10:45 PDT — that works for me.

Alex Chen
Head of ML, Pathfinder.ai
alex@pathfinder.ai | +1 206-555-0212

Alex — thanks for the quick reply and for confirming the metric set. Quick answers inline below and a couple of prep notes for the kickoff: 

> Security question: do you have a short checklist we can share with our security reviewer (SOC2 attestation, data residency, logging/audit capabilities)?

Yes — we keep a concise security intake checklist for pilots that covers: SOC 2 Type II status, encryption in transit and at rest, optional VPC/private deployment notes, retention policies, and sample audit log fields. I’ve added a short one-pager to the MAP doc under the "Security & Compliance" section and included a link to our compliance portal in the doc.

Kickoff prep (owner):
- Data: Alex — please confirm test dataset access (S3 URI or sample export) and any privacy redaction needs.
- Tech leads: Marissa & Ben — we’ll bring an integration checklist and proposed runbook for the first 14 days.
- Legal/Procurement: Procurement team — once we complete the pilot acceptance criteria, we’ll surface the minimal SOW language to speed procurement review.

We’ll plan for Tue 6/22 10:00–10:45 PDT. I’ve tentatively booked that slot on our side. If procurement needs a later slot, happy to swap.

Attachments: I’ve attached the slide skeleton and updated the MAP with a one-pager for security. Please add comments to the doc where useful.

Best —
Priyom

Looping in a few prep notes from the tech side:

- Runbook: I’ll post a 14-day runbook in the MAP doc by EOD. It will include sample curl commands for test traffic, a KV-cache warmup step, and what telemetry to collect for the quality signal.
- Demo artifacts: Ben will prepare a short demo showing sample outputs + latency profile on a small dataset.
- Spike asks: Alex, if you can confirm the sample export format (CSV vs JSONL) we’ll make sure the ingestion path is covered.

Priyom — I also added a "close criteria" draft in the MAP (acceptance matrix with pass/fail thresholds) — please review and adjust thresholds if you want them looser/tighter.

Marissa
